mapper.select: SELECT id, plan_code, display_name, description, billing_period, price_minor, currency, feature_set, scope, external_product_id, external_price_id, active, created_at, updated_at FROM plan_catalog WHERE id = #{id}::uuid

SELECT id, plan_code, display_name, description, billing_period, price_minor, currency, feature_set, scope, external_product_id, external_price_id, active, created_at, updated_at FROM plan_catalog WHERE plan_code = #{planCode}

SELECT id, plan_code, display_name, description, billing_period, price_minor, currency, feature_set, scope, external_product_id, external_price_id, active, created_at, updated_at FROM plan_catalog WHERE external_price_id = #{externalPriceId}

SELECT id, plan_code, display_name, description, billing_period, price_minor, currency, feature_set, scope, external_product_id, external_price_id, active, created_at, updated_at FROM plan_catalog WHERE active = true ORDER BY plan_code ASC

SELECT id, plan_code, display_name, description, billing_period, price_minor, currency, feature_set, scope, external_product_id, external_price_id, active, created_at, updated_at FROM plan_catalog ORDER BY plan_code ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plan_catalog (id, plan_code, display_name, description, billing_period, price_minor, currency, feature_set, scope, external_product_id, external_price_id, active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (COALESCE(#{id}::uuid, gen_random_uuid()), #{planCode}, #{displayName}, #{description}, #{billingPeriod}, #{priceMinor}, COALESCE(#{currency}, 'USD'), #{featureSet}, #{scope}, #{externalProductId}, #{externalPriceId}, COALESCE(#{active}, true), COALESCE(#{createdAt}, now()), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, now()))
mapper.update: UPDATE plan_catalog SET display_name = #{displayName}, description = #{description}, billing_period = #{billingPeriod}, price_minor = #{priceMinor}, currency = #{currency}, feature_set = #{featureSet}, scope = #{scope}, external_product_id = #{externalProductId}, external_price_id = #{externalPriceId}, active = #{active}, updated_at = now() WHERE plan_code = #{planCode}
